sources.label: In-app feedback · rjt · Sun Sep 20 · 9:30am PT · build 25 · bug

bugs.detail: Whenever you click into certain posts (usually still images), youre kind of unable to click out of them or do anything. For most things you can just swipe down and it’ll work but it doesn’t work for certain posts like some images for some reason. I’d suggest adding like an x button at the top left whenever you click into a post, similar to how insta has it. Also, when you click the arrow to go to the next slide in a post, there’s no arrow to go to the previous slide. (Also I genuinely love this app, keep up the good work ♥️)
